purpose: Governed contract for a real survey-outcome prediction baseline.

target.name: survey_positive
target.population: Calls with a completed and successfully linked customer survey.
target.interpretation: Conditional probability that a completed survey is positive.
does_not_measure: Probability that a customer completes a survey
Synthetic portfolio CSAT, NPS, QA, or Five Stars fixtures

excluded_feature_families: free-text transcript or customer personal data
limitations: Completed-survey labels may be affected by survey-response selection bias.
Protected attributes are not present and must never be inferred; a governed fairness dataset is required for a fairness audit.
Association does not establish that an agent behavior caused a survey result.
No probability may be displayed until the training gates and evaluation checks pass on real labels.
